title: French Special Challenges
delivery: optional scenario missions and weekly boss challenges

challenges.title: Pronunciation Lab
challenges.scenario: Produce five vowel pairs and shadow a short greeting clip.
challenges.fallback: If audio is unavailable, use the written script and self-record.

challenges.title: First Contact Interview
challenges.scenario: Interview a simulated new contact for 90 seconds.

challenges.title: Room Investigator
challenges.scenario: Inspect a visual room and report what exists and where it is.
success_criteria: distinguishes il y a from est

challenges.title: Day-in-the-Life Briefing
challenges.scenario: Give a 90-second briefing about a person’s home, possessions, routine, and one negative fact.

challenges.title: Café Under Pressure
challenges.scenario: Order food while the server asks one unexpected follow-up question.

challenges.title: Market Negotiation
challenges.scenario: Buy two items, ask the price, clarify one item, and close the exchange.

challenges.title: Shared Interests
challenges.scenario: Find one shared preference with a simulated partner and give a reason.

challenges.title: Calendar Coordinator
challenges.scenario: Arrange a meeting for tomorrow, change the time once, and confirm the plan.

challenges.title: Lost-and-Found Route
challenges.scenario: Ask where a place is and follow a two-step route, requesting repetition once.

challenges.title: No-English Repair Round
challenges.scenario: Hold a conversation in which three words are deliberately hidden. Stay in French using paraphrase and clarification.

challenges.title: Final Mission: Everyday Spanish
challenges.scenario: Complete a 3–5 minute conversation: meet someone, exchange origin and routine, state a preference and reason, make a plan, ask for help or directions, and repair one misunderstanding.
success_criteria: answers at least two follow-up questions
produces at least five original sentences
challenges.feedback_focus: comprehensibility, turn-taking, retrieval, and strategic repair

challenges.title: Seven-Day Recovery Challenge
challenges.scenario: The app selects the learner’s ten weakest review items from Weeks 1–4 and builds a mixed retrieval circuit.
